review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: The Network Engineer is responsible for the design, deployment, administration, security, and ongoing support of the organization’s network and IT infrastructure. Working under the direction of the IT Infrastructure Manager, this role supports enterprise connectivity, data center and server infrastructure, telecommunications, network security, wireless environments, monitoring systems, and related technologies. The Network Engineer plays a key role in maintaining reliable, secure, and highly available IT services across all organizational locations. This includes identifying infrastructure issues, implementing improvements, supporting technology upgrades, and helping ensure business-critical systems remain operational. The responsibilities outlined below represent the primary functions of the position but are not intended to be an exhaustive list. ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES Network Infrastructure Administer and support enterprise LAN and WAN environments across multiple locations. Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching infrastructure . Manage network addressing, subnetting, routing, and overall IP architecture. Configure and maintain Cisco WAN routers , including environments utilizing EIGRP, DMVPN , and other applicable routing technologies. Design, implement, and maintain wireless network infrastructure, including Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Access Points (APs) . Plan and execute network additions, deletions, upgrades, and significant infrastructure modifications. Design and support connectivity provided through multiple transport technologies, including Metro Ethernet, cellular, Internet, and other carrier services . Manage Internet connectivity across multiple providers and support BGP routing configurations. Maintain network infrastructure documentation, diagrams, configurations, and technical specifications. Network Security Administer and maintain network security technologies including Cisco Firepower and ASA firewalls . Configure and manage Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and associated network access controls. Maintain network Access Control Lists (ACLs) and other security controls. Administer and support Cisco Web Security Appliance (WSA) technologies where applicable. Manage and maintain Cisco Duo two-factor authentication (2FA) solutions. Assist with the implementation of network security improvements, policies, and infrastructure upgrades. Monitor network security and infrastructure environments for potential issues and vulnerabilities. Voice & Communications Administer and support VoIP phone systems and Cisco Call Manager . Maintain Cisco Unity voicemail and Emergency Responder systems. Support Cisco UCCX Call Center environments. Troubleshoot voice, telecommunications, and network-related communication issues. Ensure voice and communication platforms maintain appropriate levels of availability and performance. Remote Access & Network Services Configure and maintain remote-access solutions, including Cisco AnyConnect VPN . Support and maintain site-to-site VPN connectivity. Administer core network services such as DNS and DHCP . Support servers, appliances, and related infrastructure components. Assist with infrastructure server and appliance upgrades, replacements, and technology refresh initiatives. Infrastructure Operations & Support Serve as a technical lead for complex troubleshooting, system backups, and disaster recovery activities. Participate in the design, implementation, maintenance, and replacement of IT systems, hardware, software, and infrastructure. Troubleshoot servers, network appliances, communication systems, and associated technologies. Monitor the IT infrastructure using enterprise monitoring and alerting tools. Investigate network performance and availability issues, determine root causes, and implement corrective actions. Identify opportunities to improve network reliability, resiliency, performance, and uptime. Provide after-hours and emergency technical support as part of the required on-call rotation . Assist with infrastructure-related projects from planning and design through implementation and support. Remain current on emerging networking and infrastructure technologies through professional development, technical training, industry publications, seminars, conferences, and professional organizations. Collaborate with IT team members and other departments to resolve technical issues and accomplish organizational objectives. Perform other duties as assigned. REQUIRED / PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems (MIS), Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline preferred. Minimum of three years of professional experience supporting LAN, WAN, and enterprise network environments . Equivalent combinations of education, technical training, and professional experience may be considered. Cisco CCNA and/or CCNP certification preferred. Demonstrated experience working with Cisco switches, routers, wireless infrastructure, and VoIP technologies . Previous experience in a casino or gaming environment is preferred. Must meet applicable age requirements for the position. Must successfully complete the required background screening. Ability and willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and respond to infrastructure issues outside normal business hours. Ability to travel as required. TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS The successful candidate should possess strong working knowledge of: Cisco networking technologies LAN/WAN architecture Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching IP addressing and subnetting Ethernet technologies IP routing protocols EIGRP DMVPN BGP Wireless networking Cisco WLC and AP infrastructure Cisco routers and switches Cisco Firepower Cisco ASA Cisco ISE Network ACLs Cisco Web Security Appliance Cisco Duo 2FA VPN technologies, including Cisco AnyConnect and site-to-site VPN DNS and DHCP VoIP and Cisco Call Manager Cisco Unity Cisco UCCX Emergency Responder Network monitoring and management tools Server and appliance infrastructure Backup and disaster recovery technologies Network security principles, technologies, and best practices CORE COMPETENCIES Strong network troubleshooting and diagnostic capabilities across networking, telecommunications, hardware, and infrastructure platforms. Ability to analyze network architecture and determine reliable, scalable, and cost-effective solutions. Ability to design, install, configure, upgrade, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. Understanding of the OSI model , Ethernet, switching, routing, wireless networking, firewalls, and network communications. Ability to develop network diagrams and maintain detailed technical documentation. Ability to participate in network architecture and infrastructure design sessions. Ability to develop and execute testing scenarios for network, communication, and infrastructure components. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple technically complex projects simultaneously. Strong organizational, documentation, and project coordination skills. Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across a diverse organization. Ability to research emerging technologies and make recommendations regarding infrastructure improvements. Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a technical team. Ability to travel when necessary.
